lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Base to +e2 side leg, ~90.9 deg formed fold. Perpendicular sections at 2/25/50/75/98% put the label point on the bottom of the outer-skin arc, 0.01-0.25 mm from the nearest surface point, centred on the bisector; the inner skin is about 3.7 mm further in. Parallel to the fold. The outer apex surface is present for t of about -1 to 122.5 mm, and the line runs 0 to 121.6, so it covers about 98% of the visible fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Base to -e2 side leg, ~90.7 deg formed fold. Sections at 25/50/75% show the label on the outer arc apex at 0.03-0.2 mm. Parallel. The apex surface spans t of about -1 to 122.5 mm, against a line of 0 to 121.4, so it covers about 98%. Past both ends the surface drops away by more than 3 mm because of the corner relief and open-end rounding.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Base to end wall at the short end, ~90.2 deg formed fold. Sections at 25/50/75% show the label on the outer arc apex at 0.03-0.25 mm. Parallel. The apex surface is present for t of about -1.5 to 37.5 mm, against a line of 0 to 35.9, so it covers about 93-95%. Sections past both ends (t=-6/-4 and 40/42) show the V-shaped corner relief notch and the flat lower part of the end wall overlapping the leg ends. Neither is a second fold.
